landing.badge: Engineered by Krish Verma • International Fintech Platform
landing.heroSubtitle: Artha brings automated income and expense tracking, category budgets, algorithmic spending velocity alerts, and 5 Indian regional languages into a unified financial operating system.
landing.pillarsTitle: A serious financial platform, not a toy dashboard
landing.pillarsSubtitle: Every interaction is carefully constructed to prioritize financial data density, accessibility, and high contrast.
landing.feature1Desc: Dynamic Recharts visualization mapping income vs expense trends across customizable timeframes with Indian currency lakh/crore formatting.
landing.feature2Desc: Allocate monthly caps for dining, rent, travel, and investments. Automated warnings prevent over-budget runaway before month-end.
landing.feature3Desc: Rule-based algorithmic insights comparing month-over-month velocity, top expenditure drivers, and deficit warnings strictly from actual data.
landing.panIndiaTitle: Designed for India. Fully translatable in 5 major languages.
landing.panIndiaDesc: Financial decisions are personal. Artha seamlessly transitions across English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, and Telugu without full page reloads.
landing.securityItem1: HTTP-Only Cookie Isolation: Session tokens are protected against XSS and never accessible via JavaScript localStorage.
landing.securityItem2: Multi-Factor Verification: Flexible authentication with Mobile OTP (SHA-256 hashed), Google OAuth, and bcrypt (12 rounds).
landing.securityItem3: Zero Leakage Authorization: Every transaction and budget query strictly verified on the backend with authenticated user context.
landing.bannerTitle: Take complete control of your financial runway today
landing.bannerSubtitle: Experience the next standard of personal finance management with live analytics and budget alerts.
